sources.articleTitle: Kane says England appearance record a ‘testament to dedication’
Kane makes record 126th appearance for England

headline: Harry Kane Sets New England Men's Football Appearance Record
seoTitle: Harry Kane Sets England Appearance Record
metaDescription: Harry Kane has become the most capped player in England's men's football history, surpassing the long-standing record held by Peter Shilton.
aiSummaryBullets: Harry Kane earned his 126th cap for the England national football team.
The achievement surpasses the previous record of 125 appearances held by Peter Shilton since 1990.
Kane described the milestone as a reflection of his dedication to the sport.
aiContextParagraph: Harry Kane has officially surpassed Peter Shilton to become the most-capped player in the history of the England men's national football team. The milestone occurred during a match at Wembley Stadium, marking Kane's 126th appearance for his country. Peter Shilton, a former goalkeeper who set the previous record in 1990, held the title for over three decades before being overtaken by Kane. Following the match, Kane characterized the accomplishment as a significant testament to his commitment and dedication to professional football. This transition in the national team's record books marks a notable moment in English football history, documenting the shift from a defensive-focused record holder to the current captain and forward who has consistently represented the national side over his career. Kane remains a central figure for the team as he continues his tenure with the national squad.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction across international sports media outlets due to the breaking of a major national sporting record that had stood for thirty-six years.
